name: SB's Enchantment Effects
summary: Client-side particles and sounds for enchantments that scale with level, making combat enchantments look more impactful.

mechanics.title: Effects by enchantment
mechanics.description: Sharpness: magic slash. Smite: holy beam. Bane of Arthropods: banish effect. Fire Aspect: rings of fire (more with level). Knockback: gusts of wind. Thorns: guardian-style shield that strikes attackers.

mechanics.title: Planned
mechanics.description: Effects for bow, trident and mace enchantments are planned but not yet present.
